ns2:section.sectionText: Risk Management Practices & Regulation. This course offers a comprehensive coverage of different aspects of risks and regulation of financial institutions. Topics include financial institutions and their trading, risk management frameworks, market risk, interest rate risk, liquidity risk, credit risk, operational risk, latest industry practices and regulation, including Basel and Solvency, fundamental review of trading books, scenario analysis and stress testing, etc. This section is an "approved section of ASRM 499" for purposes of the Actuarial Science undergraduate major.
